purpose: Close the production-only STAR fields without changing the preregistered primary, denominator, redlines, or claim boundary after seeing local results.

required_external_inputs.minimum_capability: metadata-only access to tables, columns, constraints, indexes, grants, RLS policies, triggers, functions, migration/version metadata, and PostgreSQL version
desensitized intent, outcome, version, mutation, receipt, outbox, latency, retry, and failure-class events for the selected write entry
a frozen 14-to-30-day flag-off window or an owner-approved equivalent powered window using the same event definitions
stable tenant or user hash allocation, immediate kill switch, receipt lookup on ambiguous outcomes, and permission to advance 1, 5, 25, 50, then 100 percent only when gates pass
owner authorization for production observation and writes plus independent review of the exact candidate and measurement contract

production_measurement_contract.formula: 10000 * stale expected-version intents leaving any local or formal partial effect / all eligible selected-entry stale-conflict intents
production_measurement_contract.failure_retention: timeouts, retries, denials, conflicts, ambiguous outcomes, and candidate-caused missing telemetry remain in the denominator
production_measurement_contract.allocation_mode: single formal writer per intent; production dual-write forbidden
production_measurement_contract.redline_stop_rule: any duplicate formal write, unauthorized or cross-tenant write, mutation/outbox divergence, data loss, or unrecoverable committed outcome sets allocation to zero

completion_outputs: content-free production schema snapshot hash and declared diff
raw numerator and denominator for every arm and allocation stage
one-sided 95 percent primary bound using the frozen estimator
normal-write success, receipt coverage, p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, outbox delivery, and recovery metrics
production_improvement_claim set true only if every prerequisite and decision gate passes
current_conclusion: No local tool or model is missing. Only production-owned evidence and authority prevent a production improvement claim; all safe local experiments are complete.
